title: Tibetan Soundscape: Sera, the Jokhang roof, a Lhasa backstreet, a pilgrim's kora
license: unknown (field recordings uploaded to archive.org, no licence stated)
notes: Seven field recordings concatenated in the uploader's order (see srcWindows). Windows: Sera Monastery's daily debate; twice the work song of the rammers compacting the Jokhang's adobe roof; the driver and guide talking Tibetan on the road; a liturgic music class overheard in a Lhasa backstreet; a pilgrim chanting his kora round the Jokhang. Cut with --band low. The tent-wind file at Qomolangma was dropped as too quiet to survive the receiver, and the car-radio file as not Tibetan.
